productsSection.title: Materials across critical construction layers.
productsSection.description: Nine product categories support construction, finishing, protection and repair applications.
productsSection.featuredTitle: Three products. One complete tiling system.
productsSection.featuredDescription: Specified adhesives and grout for general tiling, demanding installations and durable joint finishing.

featuredProducts.name: Tile Adhesive (Semi-Flexible)
featuredProducts.description: A polymer-modified cementitious adhesive for fixing interior and exterior ceramic tiles, available in grey or white.
highlights: Extended open time and slight flexibility
Suitable for MiC factory and site works
featuredProducts.imageAlt: TA313 tile adhesive being used to install wall tiles

featuredProducts.name: Tile Adhesive (Flexible)
featuredProducts.description: A high-polymer, high-strength flexible adhesive developed for interior and exterior wall and floor tile installations.
highlights: Designed for large and heavy tiles
Suitable for MiC factory and site works
featuredProducts.imageAlt: TA328 flexible tile adhesive being applied during wall tiling

featuredProducts.name: Tile Grout (High Performance)
featuredProducts.description: A decorative polymer-modified cementitious grout for strong, hard-wearing and water-resistant tile joints.
highlights: Recommended for joint widths from 1–15 mm
featuredProducts.imageAlt: TG410E high-performance tile grout being finished between floor tiles
